limitations: POI and transit proximity are evidence of access, not measured footfall.
Metro DX, SA, and SU patronage prefixes are retained without inferred day meanings.
ACS values are survey estimates; margins of error are not incorporated in this fixture.
Park and tract geometries are clipped to the Pacoima analysis boundary.
ACS total population is an area-weighted intersecting-tract context estimate; it is not apportioned to or claimed as a tile population.
For each stop, use the maximum published boardings plus alightings across retained DX, SA, and SU categories without assigning meanings to those day-code prefixes; then sum stops in a tile.
Cooling opportunity represents evidence of an actionable public site or transit waiting area; no canopy, shade, or surface condition is inferred.
Points outside the returned heat-tile coverage by at most 25 meters are assigned to the nearest tile and explicitly flagged as proximity joins; farther points remain unmatched.

Exceedance hours are normalized from the frozen 2024-07-15 layer; the active TCM and persistence layers are dated 2026-08-20. The weighted heat score therefore uses exceedance as historical context, not as a contemporaneous observation.
Peak heat hour is cached UTC context from 2024-07-15; it is not evidence of peak pedestrian activity and is not used in scoring.
Scores are relative modeled priorities normalized within this frozen Pacoima dataset; they are not measured cooling effects or predictions of people protected.
